scope: Controlled CPU backend experiment; preserve the existing released encoder/matrix/gaps and exact filter semantics. No search repository edits.
queries: First 10 R1 validation queries by deterministic SHA256 R3 ordering; fixed across target strata and sizes
data: Existing SCOPe40 archive only; unique record ID, AA hash and raw structure hash; exclude query PDBs; single chain, complete backbone, >=95% valid peptide links
mixed_stratum: Additional 60-500 length pool for the 5000-target scaling point when individual length strata are too small
shortfall: Skip impossible sizes with exact available counts; never inflate by duplicating structures
selection: Nested target prefixes by SHA256('R3:'+record_id), independent of scores; length range is target length
comparisons: Cumulative changes, same candidate sets and scores; baseline Python traceback, last backend Numba traceback with identical tie rules and independent rescoring
order: Rotate backend order by repeat; execute serially
timing: Separate cold JIT, structure encoding, index conversion, array preparation, warm score-only search, top-1 traceback/rescore, output; report median and min/max
preflight: One smallest target condition per length stratum, project larger runs with a 3x work reserve; refuse estimates above remaining 4-hour/4GiB limits
adoption: Candidate/score/path equivalence first; >=1.5x warm total speedup at >=2 distinct target sizes. Filter retention relative to exhaustive is reported separately, never attributed to backend.
biological_claim: Throughput diagnostic using real structures, not a fresh biological test or training generalization study
